shared_elements: bearded male figure(s) with elaborately rendered curled hair/beard
stylized plant/tree with repeated foliage units
figures facing right in procession-like orientation
justification: Both are low-relief profile scenes with bearded male figures whose hair and beard are rendered as regular rows of tight curls, textured patterned garments, a horned animal, and a stylized plant with repeated leaf/floret units — a shared repertoire and rendering convention. But the depicted scenes differ sharply: A is a horizontal procession of men leading two live rams past a tree, while B is a single large winged, horned-cap figure with raised arm beside a stylized flowering tree, filling the whole field with no processional band or led livestock.
